state.task: Choose the reasoning effort (and model) an agentic assistant should use for the next user message. It reads files, runs tools and edits things, not only code. Pick the cheapest that still does the job well.
state.next_message: rename one variable in a single file

effort.instructions: Which effort fits the next message?

criteria.low: quick answer, no tools, no planning
criteria.medium: normal work: a few tool calls or edits
criteria.high: hard or large multi-step job: many tool calls, costly mistakes

model.instructions: Which model fits the next message?

criteria.sonnet: normal coding, edits across a few files, explanations, writing
criteria.opus: hard debugging, architecture, large refactors, careful reviews
criteria.fable: the hardest long-horizon or research-level work
